title: 第199章 六劲合一虚空破阵眼第198章 双拳破隔墙工友相见
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
苏意从破洞里钻过去。
脚踩实的瞬间，他微微屏住了呼吸。
不是虚空，不是擂台，不是石室。
是一座城。
一座被废弃了不知多少年的巨型武道城池，在黑暗中沉默地铺展到视线尽头。
城池的规模和武道城相当，但所有建筑都是用苏意从未见过的青黑色石料砌成——石料表面嵌满了已经黯淡的魂晶碎片和另一种更古老的发光矿石。
矿石的光芒极弱极淡，像蜡烛被风吹灭前最后一跳，但满城密密麻麻的矿石同时发光，把整座遗城笼罩在一片极淡极稳的暗青色天光里。
城墙上的拳架图从城门口一直延伸到城墙尽头。
不是八极，不是形意，不是太极——是一种融合了所有国术拳架特点的综合性拳谱。
八极的铁山靠和形意的崩拳被画在同一幅图里，两种拳劲的发力路线互相穿插交织，形成一个苏意从未见过的复合劲力走向。
劈挂的鞭劲和太极的化劲被拆解后重新组合，鞭劲的发力和化劲的卸力在同一瞬间完成。
每一幅图旁边都有古文字注解，刻痕极深极稳，入石数寸。
矿神在苏意体内逐字逐句翻译那些古文字，声音比平时低了半调，带着一种从未有过的凝重。
“上古武道联盟总部遗址。上古武道联盟在矿局建立之前是三十六重天的主宰。他们不用灵力不用魂晶，靠国术拳劲打穿虚空建立了这座遗城。矿局倾巢而出攻打了数百年才夺取魂晶矿脉。联盟覆灭，遗城被封入天外天，所有武道禁制也被一并封印——直到你激活武道石碑、打穿四十二重天的禁制，封印才解开。”
班定远从后面走上来，站在苏意身边抬头看着城墙上的拳架图。
他看了很久，忽然伸手在图上八极和形意交汇的位置点了一下——那一指的位置和苏意在禁制门前打出的崩拳退步落点完全一致。
“这图老子看了数百年。不是看，是打。老子在这面墙上打了数百年撑锤，打进去的每一拳都被墙外的人用同一种拳劲接住。”
他转头看向从破洞另一边走过来的陈铁柱。
陈铁柱比班定远瘦得多，颧骨高耸，眼窝深陷，身上穿着一件破烂到看不出原本颜色的矿局旧工装。
右臂上有和苏意一模一样的魂晶痕迹——但比苏意的更淡更老，边缘已经模糊得快要消散。

他被关得太久了，魂晶碎片里的能量几乎耗尽，只剩最后一丝残光还在微微跳动。
“陈铁柱。”
班定远替他说了名字，“和老子同期穿越。比老子早一步被矿局抓去当了魂晶核心的活体容器。矿局把他的意识封进魂晶母矿最深处，但他在被封进去之前用最后的意识把自己的拳意打进了天外天的裂缝。然后就困在这头困了漫长岁月。”
陈铁柱咧嘴笑了笑，满口牙还剩两颗。
“你叫苏意？矿神在你体内？好。好得很。矿局在老子体内封了不知多少年，把老子当魂晶核心的活体电池用——他们不知道老子被封进去之前是工地上打桩的。打桩机你见过没？那玩意儿一锤下去整个工地都在震。老子在魂晶核心里把打桩机的劲力和八极拳叠在一起，从里面往外打，打了不知多少年才在天外天打出一道裂缝。就这道裂缝——”
他指了指身后那道还在发光的裂缝，“矿局到现在都不知道这道裂缝是怎么来的。他们以为是矿脉自然塌陷，不知道是老子一拳一拳打出来的。”
他咳了两声，瘦削的胸口剧烈起伏了几下，然后抬手朝遗城最高处指去。
城池正中央的最高点立着一座保存完好的石殿，石殿外墙用和城门同一种青黑色石料砌成，殿顶嵌着一枚还在缓缓旋转的暗金色光球——那是源晶母石，和第六重天古城墙上嵌着的源晶核心碎片同一种材质，但更大更完整，光芒更沉更稳。
“那座殿是上古武道联盟的盟主殿。殿里存放着联盟覆灭前留下的最后一件遗物——全套国术融合拳谱。”
陈铁柱收回手指，“联盟盟主在城破前将毕生所学融为一套拳法刻在石壁上，命名为‘武道归宗’。不是新拳法，是把八极、形意、太极、劈挂、咏春、八卦六种拳劲融合在一起的使用方法。老夫在裂缝这头困了这么久，每天隔着墙和老班对拳，对到后来发现我们两个人的拳劲可以叠在一起打穿活墙。这就是武道归宗的原理——不是六种拳劲各打各的，是六种拳劲叠在一起，互相借力互相补劲。”
content_en:
Su Yi got through the hole.
The moment his feet hit the ground, he held his breath slightly.
Not the void, not the arena, not the stone chamber.
It's a city.
A giant martial arts city that had been abandoned for countless years spread silently in the darkness to the end of the sight.
The size of the city is similar to that of Martial Arts City, but all the buildings are made of blue-black stone that Su Yi has never seen before - the surface of the stone is embedded with dimmed soul crystal fragments and another older luminous ore.
The light of the ore was very weak and light, like the last flicker of a candle before it was blown out by the wind, but the densely packed ore all over the city glowed at the same time, shrouding the entire ruined city in a very light and stable dark blue sky light.
The boxing pictures on the city wall extend from the city gate to the end of the city wall.
It’s not Baji, Xingyi, or Tai Chi—it’s a comprehensive boxing spectrum that combines the characteristics of all Chinese martial arts.
Baji's Tieshanyao and Xingyi's Bengquan are drawn in the same picture, and the power routes of the two fist powers are intertwined with each other, forming a composite power trend that Su Yi has never seen before.
The whip strength of Pigua and the Hua strength of Tai Chi are disassembled and reassembled. The exertion of Whip strength and the discharge of Hua strength are completed at the same instant.
There are ancient text annotations next to each picture. The carvings are very deep and stable, and they are several inches deep into the stone.
The Mine God translated those ancient texts word for word in Su Yi's body, his voice was half a tone lower than usual, with a solemnity that he had never heard before.
"The ruins of the headquarters of the Ancient Martial Arts Alliance. Before the establishment of the Mining Bureau, the Ancient Martial Arts Alliance was the master of the Thirty-sixth Heaven. They did not use spiritual power or soul crystals, but relied on the martial arts to punch through the void to build this ruined city. The Mining Bureau went out to attack for hundreds of years before seizing the soul crystal veins. The alliance was destroyed, the ruined city was sealed into the outer world, and all the martial arts restrictions were also sealed - it was not until you activated the martial arts stele and penetrated the restrictions of the forty-two heavens that the seal was released."
Ban Dingyuan came up from behind, stood next to Su Yi and looked up at the boxing diagram on the wall.
He looked at it for a long time, and suddenly reached out and clicked on the map where Baji and Xingyi intersected - the position of that finger was exactly the same as the retreat point of Su Yi's Bengquan in front of the restricted door.
"I've been looking at this picture for hundreds of years. I'm not looking at it, I'm punching it. I've been hitting this wall with a hammer for hundreds of years. Every punch I punched in was caught by the people outside the wall with the same punch."
He turned to look at Chen Tiezhu, who was coming from the other side of the hole.
Chen Tiezhu is much thinner than Ban Dingyuan, with tall cheekbones and sunken eye sockets. He is wearing an old work uniform from the Mining Bureau that is so tattered that the original color cannot be seen.
There are traces of soul crystals on his right arm that are exactly the same as Su Yi's - but they are lighter and older than Su Yi's, and the edges are blurred to the point of dissipating.
He had been locked up for too long, and the energy in the soul crystal fragments was almost exhausted, with only the last trace of light still beating slightly.
"Chen Tiezhu."
Ban Dingyuan said his name for him, "I traveled at the same time as me. He was captured by the mining bureau one step ahead of me and used as a living container for the soul crystal core. The mining bureau sealed his consciousness into the deepest part of the soul crystal mother mine, but before he was sealed in, he used his last consciousness to drive his fist into the crack in the sky. Then he was trapped here for a long time."
Chen Tiezhu grinned, with two teeth left in his mouth.
"Your name is Su Yi? The God of Mine is in your body? Okay. Very good. The Mining Bureau has sealed me inside my body for who knows how many years, using me as a living battery for the core of the soul crystal - they don't know that I was driving piles on the construction site before I was sealed in. You see the pile driver? Did you pass? The whole construction site shook when the thing was hammered down. I combined the power of the pile driver with the Baji Fist in the core of the soul crystal, and beat it from the inside out. It took me countless years to create a crack in Tianwaitian—"
He pointed to the still glowing crack behind him, "The Mine Bureau still doesn't know where this crack came from. They thought it was the natural collapse of the mineral vein, but they didn't knowI punched it out one by one. "
He coughed twice, his thin chest heaved violently several times, and then he raised his hand and pointed towards the highest point of the ruined city.
At the highest point in the center of the city stands a well-preserved stone palace. The outer wall of the stone palace is made of the same blue-black stone as the city gate. On the top of the palace is embedded a slowly rotating dark golden ball of light - it is the source crystal mother stone. It is the same material as the source crystal core fragment embedded in the ancient city wall of the Sixth Heaven, but it is larger and more complete, and the light is deeper and more stable.
“That palace is the alliance leader’s palace of the Ancient Martial Arts Alliance. Stored in the hall is the last relic left before the alliance's collapse - a complete set of Chinese martial arts fusion boxing manuals. "
Chen Tiezhu retracted his finger and said, "Before the city was destroyed, the leader of the alliance integrated all the boxing techniques he had learned throughout his life into a set of boxing techniques and carved them on the stone wall, naming it 'Martial Arts Return to the Sect'. It is not a new boxing technique, but a method that integrates the six boxing techniques of Baji, Xingyi, Tai Chi, Pigua, Wing Chun and Bagua. I have been trapped on this side of the crack for so long, and I boxed with Lao Ban across the wall every day. Eventually, I discovered that the two of us could punch through the living wall with our combined punches. This is the principle of martial arts return to the sect - it is not that the six types of boxing power are used separately, but that the six types of boxing power are stacked together, borrowing each other's strength to supplement each other's strength. "
